security_audit.summary: Most static findings are documentation examples, Markdown code fences, or placeholder URLs rather than executable malicious behavior. Confirmed issues involve applying an unpinned remote Kubernetes manifest and recommending Helm --set for secret values. I found no prompt injection, credential exfiltration code, or hidden automation in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Pin ArgoCD installation manifests to a released version and recommend reviewing or vendoring manifests before kubectl apply.

remediation.issue: Secrets passed through Helm command arguments
remediation.suggestion: Use External Secrets Operator, sealed secrets, or protected values files. Avoid placing secret values directly in Helm command lines.

remediation.issue: Docker Buildx provenance disabled in examples
remediation.suggestion: Prefer enabled provenance for production builds and document compatibility alternatives before recommending provenance: false.

content.value_statement: Cloud Kubernetes deployments fail when build settings, secrets, and cluster architecture drift. This skill gives checklists, CI/CD patterns, and debugging flows for AKS, GKE, and DOKS.
actual_capabilities: Guide deployments to AKS, GKE, and DOKS using Helm and GitHub Actions.
Explain build-time versus runtime variables for Next.js services.
Check Kubernetes node architecture and align Docker build platforms.
Provide troubleshooting flows for ImagePullBackOff, CrashLoopBackOff, and Helm parsing errors.
Outline GitOps, observability, security context, and resilience patterns.
limitations: Does not provision cloud clusters or registry accounts by itself.
Requires users to adapt example URLs, namespaces, and secrets to their environment.
Does not validate live Kubernetes permissions or production readiness automatically.
Examples include security tradeoffs that need review before production use.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Production Release
use_cases.description: Build a deployment checklist for image architecture, Helm values, secrets, and rollout validation.

use_cases.title: Fix Cloud Deployment Failures
use_cases.description: Diagnose ImagePullBackOff, CrashLoopBackOff, wrong architecture, and Helm parsing errors.

use_cases.title: Standardize CI/CD Workflows
use_cases.description: Create GitHub Actions guidance for selective builds, Docker build arguments, and Helm releases.

prompt_templates.title: Plan My First Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a step-by-step cloud Kubernetes deployment plan for my app. Include cluster checks, image builds, Helm release steps, and rollout validation.

prompt_templates.title: Debug a Failed Rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to diagnose my failed Kubernetes rollout. I will provide pod status, events, logs, image tag, cluster architecture, and Helm command details.

prompt_templates.title: Review My CI/CD Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my GitHub Actions deployment workflow for cloud Kubernetes. Check path filters, Docker platform settings, build-time variables, Helm values, and secret handling.

prompt_templates.title: Design Production Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design production Kubernetes patterns for my service. Cover GitOps, observability, network policy, security context, autoscaling, disruption budgets, and release verification.

output_examples.input: I need to deploy a Next.js app and API to GKE with GitHub Actions.
output: A deployment plan covering build-time public variables, runtime secrets, Docker platform selection, and Helm release steps.
A checklist for validating image tags, pod status, events, and service connectivity after rollout.

output_examples.input: My pod shows ImagePullBackOff after a new release.
output: A diagnosis path that checks registry path, image tag, pull credentials, skipped builds, and architecture mismatch.
A concise action list for rebuilding the image, updating Helm values, and verifying the rollout.

output_examples.input: Review our Kubernetes production readiness plan.
output: A readiness review covering GitOps, monitoring, logging, RBAC, network policies, security contexts, probes, autoscaling, and disruption budgets.
A short risk note for unpinned remote manifests, command-line secrets, and disabled build provenance.

best_practices: Check cluster node architecture before building production images.
Separate build-time public variables from runtime secrets and configuration.
Validate rollouts with pod status, events, logs, and exact image tags.
anti_patterns: Do not assume Docker image architecture matches the Kubernetes node pool.
Do not place long-lived secret values in reusable chart defaults.
Do not skip rollout checks after a successful CI job.

faq.question: Which platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It focuses on cloud Kubernetes deployments for AKS, GKE, and DOKS. The patterns also apply to similar managed clusters.

faq.question: Can it create a Kubernetes cluster for me?
faq.answer: No. It guides deployment and troubleshooting after a cluster, registry, and credentials already exist.

faq.question: Does it support GitOps?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes ArgoCD, app manifests, Kustomize overlays, and production checklist guidance.

faq.question: Can it troubleshoot image pull failures?
faq.answer: Yes. It walks through missing tags, registry paths, pull secrets, skipped builds, and platform mismatch.

faq.question: Does it manage secrets safely by default?
faq.answer: It explains secret handling concepts, but users should review examples before production use. Prefer managed secret stores for sensitive values.

faq.question: Is it useful for Next.js deployments?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains how Next.js public variables are embedded during image builds and how runtime configuration differs.
